content.json:
# OldWeb MCP experiment
Adoption views exclude marked internal requests and every caller group also seen in marked tests within the available 60-day window. Shared networks can exclude real users; unmarked operator traffic can remain. Caller groups and client names do not verify identities. Probes lack caller identifiers and remain separate operational counts.

Launch: October 9, 2026, 13:19:14 Eastern. First listing: October 10, 2026, 13:32:51 Eastern. Baseline: about 24 hours 14 minutes. Phase uses event time, not stored tags. Returning callers require successful calls on three Eastern dates. Public access was interrupted October 12–16. Historical caller matching expires with raw telemetry.

content.title: Activity by service and phase
content.query: let activity=customEvents | where name == 'mcp_activity' and timestamp >= datetime(2026-10-09T17:19:14Z); let testCallers=activity | where tostring(customDimensions.internal)=='true' | extend caller=tostring(customDimensions.caller) | where isnotempty(caller) | distinct caller; let external=activity | where tostring(customDimensions.internal)=='false' | extend caller=tostring(customDimensions.caller) | join kind=leftanti testCallers on caller; external | where name == 'mcp_activity' | extend service=tostring(customDimensions.service), phase=iff(timestamp < datetime(2026-10-10T17:32:51.537144Z),'baseline','listed'), method=tostring(customDimensions.method), outcome=tostring(customDimensions.outcome), internal=tostring(customDimensions.internal) | where internal != 'true' | summarize Events=sum(todouble(customMeasurements.count)) by service, phase, method, outcome | order by service asc

content.title: Successful tool use and approximate repeat callers
content.query: let activity=customEvents | where name == 'mcp_activity' and timestamp >= datetime(2026-10-09T17:19:14Z); let testCallers=activity | where tostring(customDimensions.internal)=='true' | extend caller=tostring(customDimensions.caller) | where isnotempty(caller) | distinct caller; let external=activity | where tostring(customDimensions.internal)=='false' | extend caller=tostring(customDimensions.caller) | join kind=leftanti testCallers on caller; external | where name == 'mcp_activity' and tostring(customDimensions.internal) != 'true' and tostring(customDimensions.outcome) == 'tool_success' | extend service=tostring(customDimensions.service), caller=tostring(customDimensions.caller) | summarize Calls=count(), Days=dcount(format_datetime(datetime_utc_to_local(timestamp,'America/New_York'),'yyyy-MM-dd')) by service, caller | summarize SuccessfulCalls=sum(Calls), CallerGroups=count(), ReturningThreeDays=countif(Days >= 3) by service

content.json:
## Estimated validation retries
Matches the next call from the same caller group, endpoint, and known tool within ten minutes. This is association, not proof of the same task or use of repair guidance. Repeated invalid calls form separate transitions. Unknown tools cannot be matched. Test caller groups are excluded. Allow five minutes for ingestion and ten minutes for retry observation. Zero denominators show no rate. Late events, shared networks, missing events, and the 60-day retention can change results. No inputs or caller identifiers are displayed.

content.title: Validation errors followed by a retry within ten minutes (estimate)
content.query: let observationEnd=now()-5m; let cohortStart=datetime(2026-10-09T17:19:14Z); let cohortEnd=observationEnd-10m; let activity=customEvents | where name=='mcp_activity' and timestamp>=datetime(2026-10-09T17:19:14Z) and timestamp<=observationEnd; let testCallers=activity | where tostring(customDimensions.internal)=='true' | extend caller=tostring(customDimensions.caller) | where isnotempty(caller) | distinct caller; let calls=activity | where timestamp>=cohortStart | where tostring(customDimensions.internal)=='false' and tostring(customDimensions.method)=='tools/call' | extend caller=tostring(customDimensions.caller),service=tostring(customDimensions.service),tool=tostring(customDimensions.tool),outcome=tostring(customDimensions.outcome) | join kind=leftanti testCallers on caller | project timestamp,caller,service,tool,outcome; calls | sort by caller asc,service asc,tool asc,timestamp asc | serialize | extend nextTime=next(timestamp),nextCaller=next(caller),nextService=next(service),nextTool=next(tool),nextOutcome=next(outcome),previousTime=prev(timestamp),previousCaller=prev(caller),previousService=prev(service),previousTool=prev(tool) | where outcome=='validation_error' | extend matched= isnotempty(caller) and isnotempty(tool),mature=timestamp<cohortEnd, sameNext=caller==nextCaller and service==nextService and tool==nextTool | extend ambiguous=matched and ((sameNext and nextTime==timestamp) or (caller==previousCaller and service==previousService and tool==previousTool and timestamp==previousTime)),retried=matched and sameNext and nextTime>timestamp and nextTime<=timestamp+10m | extend result=case(not(mature),'pending',not(matched),'unmatchable',ambiguous,'ambiguous',not(retried),'no_observed_retry',nextOutcome=='tool_success','successful_retry',nextOutcome=='validation_error','invalid_retry','other_retry') | summarize ValidationErrors=count(),Eligible=countif(result in ('successful_retry','invalid_retry','other_retry','no_observed_retry')),SuccessfulRetries=countif(result=='successful_retry'),InvalidRetries=countif(result=='invalid_retry'),OtherRetries=countif(result=='other_retry'),NoObservedRetry=countif(result=='no_observed_retry'),Pending=countif(result=='pending'),Unmatchable=countif(result=='unmatchable'),Ambiguous=countif(result=='ambiguous') by service,tool | extend ObservedRetries=SuccessfulRetries+InvalidRetries+OtherRetries | extend SuccessPerEligibleError=iff(Eligible>0,100.0*SuccessfulRetries/Eligible,real(null)),SuccessPerObservedRetry=iff(ObservedRetries>0,100.0*SuccessfulRetries/ObservedRetries,real(null))

content.title: Tool outcomes and latency
content.query: let activity=customEvents | where name == 'mcp_activity' and timestamp >= datetime(2026-10-09T17:19:14Z); let testCallers=activity | where tostring(customDimensions.internal)=='true' | extend caller=tostring(customDimensions.caller) | where isnotempty(caller) | distinct caller; let external=activity | where tostring(customDimensions.internal)=='false' | extend caller=tostring(customDimensions.caller) | join kind=leftanti testCallers on caller; external | where name == 'mcp_activity' and tostring(customDimensions.internal) != 'true' and tostring(customDimensions.method) == 'tools/call' | extend service=tostring(customDimensions.service), tool=tostring(customDimensions.tool), outcome=tostring(customDimensions.outcome), ms=todouble(customMeasurements.durationMs) | summarize Calls=count(), Success=countif(outcome == 'tool_success'), ServiceErrors=countif(outcome == 'service_error'), ToolErrors=countif(outcome == 'tool_error'), p50=percentile(ms,50), p95=percentile(ms,95) by service, tool

content.title: Reported client identities at initialization only
content.query: let activity=customEvents | where name == 'mcp_activity' and timestamp >= datetime(2026-10-09T17:19:14Z); let testCallers=activity | where tostring(customDimensions.internal)=='true' | extend caller=tostring(customDimensions.caller) | where isnotempty(caller) | distinct caller; let external=activity | where tostring(customDimensions.internal)=='false' | extend caller=tostring(customDimensions.caller) | join kind=leftanti testCallers on caller; external | where name == 'mcp_activity' and tostring(customDimensions.internal) != 'true' and tostring(customDimensions.method) == 'initialize' | summarize Initializations=count() by Service=tostring(customDimensions.service), Client=tostring(customDimensions.clientName), Version=tostring(customDimensions.clientVersion), Outcome=tostring(customDimensions.outcome)

content.title: Telemetry gaps, throttling and probes
content.query: customEvents | where name == 'mcp_activity' and tostring(customDimensions.internal) != 'true' | where tostring(customDimensions.method) in ('probe','system') or tostring(customDimensions.outcome) in ('quota_exhausted','rate_limited','http_rate_limited','busy') | summarize Count=sum(todouble(customMeasurements.count)) by bin(timestamp,1h), Outcome=tostring(customDimensions.outcome)

content.title: Last reported month-to-date cost (USD; billing may lag)
content.query: customEvents | where name == 'mcp_cost' | summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by Period=tostring(customDimensions.period) | project timestamp, Period, CostUSD=todouble(customMeasurements.reportedCostUsd)

content.json:
## Cost and interpretation
Open Azure Cost Management filtered to resource group **rg-oldweb-mcp-experiment** for billing totals. The six-hour cost-guard workflow records reported month-to-date cost and pauses ingress at $20. Review its latest run before evaluating usage. Absence of events is not proof of zero traffic: check workspace ingestion caps and workflow health.

Final review: February 15, 2027 at 12:19:14 Eastern (17:19:14 UTC). At that review, expand only when a service has at least 100 successful external calls, five approximate caller groups, two groups returning on three days, and at least 95% success among valid admitted calls. Listing delays, outages and telemetry gaps make results inconclusive.
